trails.name: Gwynns Falls Trail
trails.description: 15+ mile urban greenway from Leakin Park through west Baltimore to Middle Branch Park on the harbor. Paved multi-use path with frequent access points.

trails.name: Jones Falls Trail
trails.description: Paved trail following the Jones Falls stream valley from Mount Washington through Druid Hill Park to the Inner Harbor.

trails.name: Herring Run Trail
trails.description: Paved path following Herring Run through Lake Montebello and northeast Baltimore parks.

trails.name: Inner Harbor Promenade
trails.description: Waterfront promenade circling Baltimore's Inner Harbor, Federal Hill, Canton, and Fells Point.

trails.name: Patapsco Rail-Trail (Baltimore)
trails.description: Rail-trail segment along the Patapsco River corridor in southwest Baltimore.

trails.name: Patapsco River Trail
trails.description: Paved path along the Patapsco River in southwest Baltimore.

trails.name: Cascade Falls Trail
trails.park: Patapsco Valley State Park — Orange Grove
trails.description: Popular loop past the 20-ft Cascade Falls in the Orange Grove area of Patapsco Valley State Park. Rocky footing, multiple stream crossings.
trails.parkingNotes: Service fee per vehicle at the Orange Grove entrance. Lot fills by 10 AM on weekends.

trails.name: Morning Choice Trail
trails.description: Ridge-spine footpath in the McKeldin area of Patapsco Valley.

trails.name: Ridge Trail — Patapsco
trails.description: Ridgetop footpath with river-valley overlooks.

trails.name: Ole Ranger Trail
trails.description: Forested loop in Patapsco Valley — rolling mixed hardwood terrain.

trails.name: Tulip Poplar Trail
trails.description: Gentle forested footpath — good for families and casual walks.

trails.name: Rockburn Branch Trail
trails.description: Loop footpath through Rockburn Branch Park, connecting to the Patapsco corridor.

trails.name: East Branch Trail — Patapsco
trails.description: Stream-corridor footpath along the East Branch of the Patapsco.

trails.name: Alberton Spring Trail
trails.description: Footpath through the former Alberton / Daniels mill town, with a spring crossing.

trails.name: Peaceful Pond Trail
trails.description: Short loop to a quiet pond inside Patapsco Valley SP.

trails.name: Old Main Line Trail
trails.description: Grade of the original B&O Old Main Line railbed, now a hiking corridor.

trails.name: Union Dam Trail
trails.description: Footpath to the historic Union Dam site along the Patapsco River.

trails.name: Baltimore & Annapolis (B&A) Trail
trails.description: 13-mile paved rail-trail from Glen Burnie to Annapolis, one of the most popular family trails in Maryland.

trails.name: South Shore Trail
trails.description: Short rail-trail segment along the former South Shore Line corridor.

trails.name: Colonial Annapolis Trail
trails.description: Maritime-heritage walking route through downtown Annapolis and surrounds.

trails.name: Torrey C. Brown (NCR) Rail Trail
trails.description: The legendary "NCR" — 20-mile crushed-stone rail-trail from Ashland to the PA state line, continuing as the York County Heritage Rail Trail to York, PA.

trails.name: Capital Crescent Trail
trails.description: Paved rail-trail from Georgetown (DC) through Bethesda to Silver Spring. MD portion runs from the DC line to the Rock Creek Trestle.

trails.name: Metropolitan Branch Trail
trails.description: Paved rail-trail extension running the PG-County side of the Red Line corridor.

trails.name: Rock Creek Trail
trails.description: Paved stream-valley trail from Lake Needwood through Rock Creek Regional Park to the DC line.

trails.name: Sligo Creek Trail
trails.description: Paved stream-valley trail from Wheaton through Takoma Park to the Anacostia.

trails.name: Northwest Branch Trail
trails.description: Stream-valley hike along the Northwest Branch with rocky, rooty terrain and the Kensington / Wheaton stretch's scenic gorge.

trails.name: Matthew Henson Trail
trails.description: Named for Arctic explorer Matthew Henson — paved stream-valley connector between Rock Creek and Wheaton.

trails.name: Western Maryland Rail Trail
trails.description: 28-mile paved rail-trail paralleling the C&O Canal Towpath from Big Pool through Hancock to Little Orleans.

trails.name: Great Allegheny Passage (MD)
trails.description: Maryland section of the 150-mile GAP connecting Pittsburgh to Cumberland, where it meets the C&O Canal Towpath for a continuous DC-to-Pittsburgh route.

trails.name: Three Notch Trail
trails.description: Southern Maryland rail-trail following the Patuxent Railroad corridor through St. Mary's County.

trails.name: Woodrow Wilson Bridge Trail
trails.description: Pedestrian/bike lane across the Woodrow Wilson Bridge over the Potomac River, linking Maryland to Alexandria, VA.

trails.name: MacArthur Boulevard Bike Path
trails.description: Paved bike/pedestrian path paralleling MacArthur Blvd from Cabin John to Great Falls.

trails.name: Historic Annapolis Trail
trails.description: Walking circuit through the historic district of Annapolis.

trails.name: Northeast Branch Trail
trails.description: Paved trail along the Northeast Branch of the Anacostia River.

trails.name: Paint Branch Trail (Prince George's)
trails.description: Paved stream-valley trail in PG County connecting College Park to Hyattsville.

trails.name: Rhode Island Avenue Trolley Trail
trails.description: Paved former-trolley right-of-way through PG County.

trails.name: Little Paint Branch Trail
trails.park: Little Paint Branch Stream Valley Park
trails.description: Paved stream-valley trail connecting Beltsville to College Park.

trails.name: Intercounty Connector Trail
trails.description: Paved bike/ped trail paralleling the MD-200 Intercounty Connector.

trails.name: WB&A Trail (Full Corridor)
trails.description: Paved rail-trail along the old Washington-Baltimore & Annapolis corridor, spanning PG, AA, and Howard Counties with an active extension project.

trails.name: C&O Canal Towpath
trails.park: Chesapeake & Ohio Canal National Historical Park
trails.description: 184.5-mile crushed-stone towpath from Georgetown (DC) to Cumberland, MD following the historic C&O Canal along the Potomac River. Maryland section covers roughly 180 miles — the signature long-distance trail of the state.
trails.parkingNotes: Multiple access points with paved parking: Great Falls, Carderock, Violette's Lock, Brunswick, Harpers Ferry, Williamsport, Hancock, Paw Paw, Cumberland.

trails.name: Tuckahoe Valley Trail
trails.description: Signature footpath through Tuckahoe State Park's valley forest.

trails.name: Creekside Cliff Trail
trails.description: Footpath along the Tuckahoe Creek with small cliff-top overlook points.

trails.name: Huckleberry Trail
trails.description: Short huckleberry-patch loop in Tuckahoe State Park.

trails.name: Tuckahoe Lake Trail
trails.description: Loop around the Tuckahoe Lake dam pond.

trails.name: Piney Branch Loop Trail
trails.description: Longer forest loop through the Piney Branch watershed.
